$comment: docs-new: orchestrator envelopes (typed seat messages; JSON Schema), design only.
title: Seat envelopes (version 1)
description: Every message between seats and the orchestration server. Unknown versions and unknown kinds are refused. Ids are fixed patterns, so no id can carry a path separator.

id.description: Opaque id with a fixed prefix and six lowercase hex characters.

role.description: The seat's role. manager is the team lead (plans and coordinates; no approval authority). server counts ticks and routes; it is not a seat. human is the person, reached only through the human channel.

from.description: Set by the server from the connection identity. An envelope whose from differs from the connection is refused. team is the team hash the seat was bound to (DEVOPS_TEAM), when it has one.

turn.description: Hand-off hops so far in this cycle. A send-back adds one.

capped.description: True when the meeting hit its turn or token cap.

online_query.description: The precise online query used at this step (section 16.13).

key_id.description: Reference to the server-held key. Never the key itself.

Signature.description: One signature item of the Done chain, recorded by the board (scripts/devops-scrum.mjs, recordSignature): a merge-ok or merge-deny (verdict ok or deny) on a chain step, a done (signed), the BA's scan (step scan: ok, hold or deny), Orchestration's merge report (step report) and the client's decision (step client). Verdict skipped is the client's risk record for a check or dependency it waived; that is not a pass. The signer is a seat's agent hash, the client or Orchestration. A BA signature may carry an override (a big matter signed despite open reported bugs, with its reason) or the lead's raise of a bug found during development. A client signature may carry a risk (who, when, what was skipped, why).

override.description: The BA signed for a big matter despite open reported bugs; the reason is required.

risk.description: The client waived a missing check or an unapproved dependency. The skipped items are not passes.

raised.description: A bug found during development: the team lead raised it to the BA before the BA signs.

SeatSetup.description: The setup payload spin-up hands each team lead (scripts/devops-allocation.mjs, setupPayload): recommended settings for the lead and its members, the versions of the systems involved, and the setup steps. Spin-up applies nothing; the receiving seat sets itself up.

BugReport.description: The BA's bug report to the client through Orchestration (scripts/devops-scrum.mjs, fileBugReport), after the team discussed the bug at the Daily Scrum: the issue, why it was reported, the proposed solutions, the files, lines and code snippets, an easy-to-read explanation and the plan of attack. The client picks a proposal, gives an alternative, or finds the behavior fine.

moduleHash.description: A module's record hash in the mind map (12 lowercase hex).

CatalogEntry.description: One module of a context catalog, shaped for the seat's job by a transformer. detail is full for a module the work names and reference for a neighbour.

batch.description: Where this message sits when a long catalog is sent in batches: its index from 0 and the count of messages.

goal.description: The item whose final signature made this update, when a finished item sent it.
